newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Polar to keep strong Banco Provincial stake - source.
newsitem.headline: Polar to keep strong Banco Provincial stake - source.

text.p: Venezuela's Polar said it would keep a large stake in leading local bank Banco Provincial although it plans to sell part of its 35 percent share to Spanish bank Banco Bilbao Vizcaya, a Polar source said.
"Polar's idea is not so much to sell out as to facilitate the entrance of an important financial group that will help consolidate the bank," said the source, who asked not to be named.
The source would not say how much Polar planned to sell, only that "it would be small" and would leave Polar on the Executive Board.
Last week BBV said it was interested in acquiring a stake in Provincial and that it had been negotiating to buy Credit Lyonnais' 17 percent share.
